payload.title: Make the US03 and US02 metric commands match metrics.sh
payload.body:
An independent grade of main (7eaf7d5) found that us03_claim_losses in metrics.sh counts every US03 event while docs/metrics.md counts only claim events, and acceptance_share describes its formula in prose. Count only claim events in metrics.sh and give acceptance_share one runnable command.
- **Hypothesis**: metric rows whose doc command and script disagree drop from 2 to 0.
- **Measurement**: run the docs/metrics.md command and bash scripts/metrics.sh on the same event log and compare the US03 numbers; grep the acceptance_share command cell for prose.
- **Success**: equal US03 numbers on a fixture log; the acceptance_share cell is one runnable command.
- **Pivot**: if claim events need all US03 events, change the doc instead of the script.
- **Anchor**: tasks.md docs/metrics.md rule (exact runnable command per metric).
